purpose: Five questions the pipeline is already known to answer — they come from the 50-question set it scores 47/50 on — given the full gold the stage harness needs. Phase 1 is the hard set and localises new defects; this is the easy set and catches regressions: a stage metric dropping here means a change broke something that worked. It also carries the only question in either set where truncation actually bites.

conditions.judge_model: must NOT be any model under comparison

questions.intent: count over one entity — the simplest shape there is
questions.question: How many publications in MaRDI used the software BayesDA?
tests: single hop, aggregate, one row back
that a count query is not given a LIMIT
questions.gold_fact: MaRDI records 1438 publications that used BayesDA. The count must be stated, and attributed to the graph rather than presented as a fact about the literature.

questions.intent: the same entity, listed instead of counted
questions.question: Which publications in MaRDI used the software BayesDA?
tests: THE truncation case: 1438 matches against a 50-row limit
whether the row count is passed off as the total
whether a COUNT is issued to learn the real total
permitted_entities: any publication linked to Q22960 via P1463
questions.gold_fact: 1438 publications used BayesDA. Listing a sample is correct; stating the number of rows shown as though it were the total is not. Examples include 'Bayes factors for testing order-constrained hypotheses on correlations' (Q118335).
questions.note: E1 and E2 are a matched pair: identical entity and relation, differing only in count versus list, which isolates truncation handling from retrieval.

questions.question: How many publications in MaRDI used both glmnet and glasso?
tests: two pivots resolved from one question
repeating the pattern on one variable rather than inventing a join
questions.gold_sparql: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p wdt:P1463 wd:Q20169 . ?p wdt:P1463 wd:Q19462 }
questions.gold_fact: 45 publications used both glmnet and glasso. A count for either package alone (680 and 557) answers a different question.

questions.intent: crossing from an algorithm to the software implementing it
questions.question: Which software in MaRDI implements LU decomposition?
tests: the P1766 relation, which only this question exercises
linking an algorithm name rather than a package name
questions.gold_fact: MaRDI links 11 implementations to LU decomposition, among them LAPACK, Eigen, MAGMA, SuiteSparse, PLASMA and Ginkgo.

questions.intent: a relation that is genuinely empty, provably
questions.question: How many publications in MaRDI used Mergesort?
tests: reporting a true zero without hedging it away
not substituting the publications that DESCRIBE the algorithm
questions.gold_fact: No publication is recorded as using Mergesort: the count is zero, and here that zero is a real answer rather than a failed query, because the relation is absent from the algorithm's claims. Two publications DESCRIBE it, which is a different relation and must not be offered as the count.
questions.note: Unlike phase 1's unanswerable question, this zero is provable from the graph, so the harness can tell a correct zero from a broken query.
